title: Areopagus and Athens
summary: The Areopagus was associated with public discussion, civic life, and philosophical/religious inquiry in Athens.
background: Paul’s address in Athens shows gospel proclamation in a setting filled with idols, discussion, and Gentile religious thought.
teachingHelp: When teaching Acts 17, show how Paul speaks biblically and wisely in a non-Jewish public setting without surrendering the gospel.
